# Secure Converter

## What
Secure Converter is a free, private image conversion tool that runs 100% in your browser. It converts JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, HEIC, and PDF files without uploading anything to a server.

## Key features
- Zero server uploads — all processing happens client-side
- Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, HEIC, PDF
- Batch conversion with parallel processing (up to 5 files at once)
- Merge images into a single PDF
- 50MB max file size per image
- Free & open source (MIT)
- No account or signup required
